meta: Aqua HK cut Meta to HK$5,537 and still lifted schedules to 22 (~HK$252 CPA), comfortably inside the good band and the best efficiency in the portfolio.
Dim Sum Library dropped to 3 schedules on HK$2,281 (~HK$760 CPA), past the HK$600 poor mark and the weakest Meta return of the two deep-dive venues.
Meta remains a thin last-click channel here: 25 combined schedules against 363 GA4 bookings across the two venues.
google: Aqua HK Google ran HK$8,814 for ~72 booking conversions at ~HK$122 CPA, inside the good band.
Dim Sum Library Google delivered ~68 conversions on HK$3,908 at ~HK$57 CPA, still the cheapest acquisition in the portfolio.
Google drove ~141 of the two venues' 363 bookings, close to two fifths of the combined total.
ga4: Aqua HK recovered to 215 bookings (+10.8% WoW) but stayed 4% under the August target of 224 and -2.7% YoY; it remains -6.8% on YTD.
Dim Sum Library was flat at 148 (-0.7% WoW, -9.8% YoY), 18% under target and -6.9% YTD — the portfolio's only sustained soft spot.
DSL's user conversion rate stays high, so its gap is traffic-side; Aqua HK's lower CVR means its gap is conversion-side.
